title: DD route locked for Universal Media Decomposer
body: Estimator classified the greenfield Universal Media Decomposer API as EPIC and explicitly recommended DD_REQUIRED; the user explicitly requires a complete canonical DD workflow, so the route is immutable. Support-Librarian confirmed there are no prior ADRs, ASRs, DDs, plans, or dead ends. Support-Researcher produced the technology report at artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-technology-research.md. Proceeding in canonical order with the eight-turn adversarial Refiner before Architect, ComplexityAdvisor, final Estimator, DDAuthor, and PatternEnforcer.

title: Final estimate completed; route to DD authorship
body: Final RnD-Estimator completed at artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-final-estimate.md. It confirms EPIC, DD_REQUIRED immutable, roughly 310 files / 1.74M chars / 59.3M weighted chars, 10 phases and critical path P0→P1→(P2/P3/P4)→P5→P6→P8→P9. All T8 U1-U7 risks and build gates remain explicit. Canonical workflow now advances to DDAuthor.

title: DDAuthor produced implementation-ready DD
body: RnD-DDAuthor completed the canonical DD at artifacts/designs/pending/DD-universal-media-decomposer.md (421 lines). It includes requirements traceability, architecture/ownership, data/events/APIs, all modality pipelines, provenance/locators, alignment/entity resolution, jobs/invalidation, search, providers, security, deployment, tests, rollout, limitations, risks, SLOs, acceptance criteria, and all-eight-turn/DD_REQUIRED statements. No blockers reported.

title: PatternEnforcer approved amended DD
body: Final PatternEnforcer gate returned AMEND_AND_PASS. It amended the DD with bounded tested modality-depth contract, typed semantic vocabulary, maintained curl/Python client examples, and clarified bounded Postgres graph-like queries/deferred graph projections. Approval report: artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-pattern-enforcer-approval.md. DD approved for downstream planning; residual risks are explicitly gated.

title: Downstream implementation plans created
body: Exec-Planner completed downstream handoff with six dependency-aware plans: artifacts/plans/pending/TASK-universal-media-decomposer-{A-foundation-authority,B-jobs-text-image,C-av-subtitles-providers,D-resolution-query-api,E-operations-docs-deployment,F-validation-release}.md, plus contracts and README under artifacts/designs/parts/universal-media-decomposer/. All plans/phases validated via plan_read; no planning blockers. Plan F explicitly covers correction→invalidation→selective-rerun E2E.
